items.name: Tin Ore
items.flavour: Grey tin ore, heavy for its size, which the Foundry buys for its bronze.

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.flavour: Greenish nickel ore, which the Foundry wants for its harder steels.

items.name: Steam Coal
items.flavour: Hard, clean-burning coal that keeps a boiler at pressure where common coal sulks.

items.name: Manganese Ore
items.flavour: Black manganese ore that marks the hands and toughens steel past the point of reason.

items.name: Fire Opal
items.flavour: An orange opal that holds a glow long after the light goes.

items.name: Cinders
items.flavour: Half-burnt coke riddled out of the ash pits, good for one more fire.

items.name: Slag Iron
items.flavour: Beads of iron picked out of the slag heaps, where the furnace let them go.

items.name: Slag Glass
items.flavour: A clear lump of glassy slag off the heaps, bottle-green and nearly flat on one face.

items.name: Burnt Tuyere
items.flavour: A bronze blast nozzle thrown out of a furnace wall, scorched but still sound in the cone.

items.name: Spoiled Casting
items.flavour: An iron casting thrown on the heap for one cold shut that nobody else would notice.

items.name: Bronze Ingot
items.flavour: Copper and tin together, a darker bar than brass and a good deal less obliging.

items.name: Nickel Steel Ingot
items.flavour: Steel with nickel in it, which shrugs off heat that would sag a common bar.

items.name: Boiler Plate
items.flavour: A rolled sheet of nickel steel, drilled for rivets and rated for more than anyone tests it at.

items.name: Manganese Steel Ingot
items.flavour: Steel so tough the file skates off it, which is the point and also the problem.

items.name: Clinker Bar
items.flavour: A long manganese steel bar for breaking the clinker that chokes a firebox grate.

items.name: Bronze Valve
items.flavour: A bronze stop valve that seats tight and opens with a quarter turn and a grunt.

items.name: Valve Key
items.flavour: A nickel steel key that fits the Foundry's square-headed valves and nobody else's.

items.name: Pressure Gauge
items.flavour: A bronze dial behind a slag-glass face, which reads what it reads whatever anyone would prefer.

items.name: Steam Injector
items.flavour: A bronze valve and a reworked tuyere cone that force water into a boiler against its own steam.

items.name: Opal Pyrometer
items.flavour: A fire opal set in a cast housing, which reads a furnace's heat by its colour.

items.name: Gauze Goggles
items.flavour: Two cups of brass wire gauze on a strap, which stop the sparks and most of the view.

items.name: Slag Wool
items.flavour: Ash-pit clinker from the cinders, blown into grey fibre by a jet of steam, fireproof and fiercely itchy.

items.name: Slag Wool Coat
items.flavour: A coat quilted thick with slag wool, which will not burn and will not let you forget it.

items.name: Smoked Lens
items.flavour: A disc of slag glass blacked over the cinders, for looking a furnace in the eye.

items.name: Furnace Goggles
items.flavour: Bronze-rimmed goggles with smoked lenses, which show a white-hot pour as a polite orange.

items.name: Slag Felt
items.flavour: Slag wool steamed and pressed into a grey felt that turns a spark and most opinions.

items.name: Studded Felt Coat
items.flavour: A long coat of slag felt, studded with slag-iron beads where the splashes land.

items.name: Bronze Eyecups
items.flavour: Two eyecups cut from the cone of a burnt tuyere, still faintly smelling of the blast.

items.name: Founder's Goggles
items.flavour: Smoked lenses in tuyere-bronze eyecups, the kind the Foundry gives its casters and seldom anyone else.

items.name: Bronze Fire Rake
items.flavour: A stoker's rake with a bronze head, for dragging a fire about and anything else that gets in the way.

items.name: Firebox Poker
items.flavour: A nickel steel poker that goes into a white-hot firebox and comes out merely annoyed.

items.name: Plate Sledge
items.flavour: A sledgehammer with a head built up from riveted boiler plate, heavy enough to settle most disputes in one.

items.name: Tapping Bar
items.flavour: A manganese steel bar for opening a furnace's taphole, which opens most other things as well.

items.name: Bronze Blunderbuss
items.flavour: A bell-mouthed bronze gun that loads with whatever is on the floor and spends it all at once.

items.name: Steam Rifle
items.flavour: A nickel steel barrel on a bronze valve, which fires on the Foundry's own steam and hisses about it after.

items.name: Gauged Steam Rifle
items.flavour: A Steam Rifle with a Pressure Gauge fitted, so you know exactly how hard it is about to kick.

items.name: Injector Rifle
items.flavour: A manganese steel rifle fed by a steam injector, which reloads itself faster than you can apologise.

items.name: Bronze Arc Rod
items.flavour: A bronze rod with a gap at the tip, where a fat blue arc lives and resents company.

items.name: Induction Coil
items.flavour: A nickel steel core under a mile of fine wire, which turns a small spark into a large opinion.

items.name: Leyden Rod
items.flavour: An Induction Coil charging a slag-glass jar, which lets go all at once when it has had enough.

items.name: Tuyere Lance
items.flavour: A Leyden Rod fired through a tuyere's bronze cone, which narrows its spark to a needle.

items.name: Bellows Plate
items.flavour: A curved plate of riveted iron prised off Old Bellows, patched and re-patched by every century that owned it.

items.name: Bronze Damper Shield
items.flavour: A bronze furnace damper with a handle riveted to the back, which shuts out heat and most other things.

items.name: Felt Splash Guard
items.flavour: A square of slag felt on a frame of sticks, held up between you and whatever is spitting.

items.name: Nickel Steel Targe
items.flavour: A round nickel steel targe that keeps its shape in heat that would curl a lesser one.

items.name: Studded Splash Guard
items.flavour: A splash guard studded with slag-iron beads, which stops a splash and, swung hard, rather more.

items.name: Boiler Plate Shield
items.flavour: Three boiler plates riveted edge to edge, which make a shield and a fair amount of noise.

items.name: Glass-Eyed Fire Screen
items.flavour: A hand-held fire screen of felt with a slag-glass window, so you can watch what you are hiding from.

items.name: Manganese Tower Shield
items.flavour: A tall manganese steel shield, heavy enough to lean on between blows.

items.name: Quilted Casting Mat
items.flavour: A quilted felt mat with a cast-iron rim, meant for the casting floor and better held up.

items.name: Bronze Cuirass
items.flavour: A bronze breastplate beaten over a stoker's barrel, which is roughly a stoker's shape.

items.name: Nickel Steel Cuirass
items.flavour: A nickel steel breastplate that stays cool for longer than the wearer does.

items.name: Caster's Apron
items.flavour: A long slag felt apron faced with slag-glass beads, for standing close to a pour and staying there.

items.name: Boiler Plate Cuirass
items.flavour: A breastplate rolled from boiler plate, with the rivet holes left in for the draught.

items.name: Tuyere-Collared Coat
items.flavour: A felt coat with a high collar stiffened by tuyere bronze, which keeps the sparks off your neck.

items.name: Clinker-Barred Cuirass
items.flavour: A spoiled casting saved from the heap and braced with clinker bar, which nobody now calls spoiled.

items.name: Bronze Kettle Hat
items.flavour: A broad-brimmed bronze helmet that sheds sparks and, at a pinch, boils water.

items.name: Slag Felt Hood
items.flavour: A slag felt hood with a slag-iron rim at the brow, which keeps the girder drips out of your eyes.

items.name: Nickel Steel Sallet
items.flavour: A nickel steel sallet with a long tail at the back for whatever drips off the roof girders.

items.name: Manganese Helm
items.flavour: A close manganese steel helm that has not yet met a girder it could not outlast.

items.name: Clinker Helm
items.flavour: A helm cast thick in the Foundry's own iron and ringed with clinker bar, which rings back when struck.

items.name: Bronze Gauntlets
items.flavour: Bronze gauntlets with jointed fingers, stiff when cold and stiffer when hot.

items.name: Slag Wool Mittens
items.flavour: Thick grey mittens of slag wool, fireproof, itchy and useless for counting change.

items.name: Nickel Steel Gauntlets
items.flavour: Nickel steel gauntlets that will hold a hot rivet for as long as you will.

items.name: Studded Felt Gloves
items.flavour: Felt gloves studded across the knuckles with slag iron, for a shift that ends in an argument.

items.name: Boiler Plate Gauntlets
items.flavour: Gauntlets cut from boiler plate, better at holding a line than a teacup.

items.name: Tuyere-Cuffed Gloves
items.flavour: Long felt gloves with bronze cuffs from a burnt tuyere, which reach into the heat and come back.

items.name: Manganese Gauntlets
items.flavour: Manganese steel gauntlets cuffed in tuyere bronze, made for reaching into a furnace wall.

items.name: Caster's Mitts
items.flavour: Heavy felt mitts lined with cast iron at the palm, for lifting what left the mould a minute ago.

items.name: Bronze Sabatons
items.flavour: Bronze foot plates that clank on the Foundry's iron floor and announce you a shift early.

items.name: Felt Overshoes
items.flavour: Slag felt overshoes for walking where the floor is warmer than it ought to be.

items.name: Nickel Steel Sabatons
items.flavour: Nickel steel sabatons that keep all ten toes through a spilled ladle.

items.name: Studded Felt Boots
items.flavour: Felt boots with slag-iron studs in the soles, which grip a wet floor and spark on a dry one.

items.name: Boiler Plate Sabatons
items.flavour: Flat-soled, riveted boiler plate sabatons, which walk over hot slag without complaint.

items.name: Tuyere-Toed Boots
items.flavour: Felt boots capped at the toe with tuyere bronze, for kicking a furnace door shut.

items.name: Clinker-Shod Sabatons
items.flavour: Sabatons shod with cut clinker bar, which grip a hot floor like a grudge.

items.name: Opal-Buckled Boots
items.flavour: Felt boots fastened with fire opal buckles, which light a dark stair for a minute or two.

items.name: Slag Felt Favour
items.flavour: A knot of grey slag felt pinned to the sleeve, which says you work the Foundry and burn slowly.

items.name: Bronze Square
items.flavour: A bronze try-square on a chain, for proving a corner true before anyone builds on it.

items.name: Beaded Felt Armband
items.flavour: A felt armband beaded with slag iron, worn on the working arm to steady it.

items.name: Valve Key Ring
items.flavour: Four Foundry valve keys on one ring, worn for the weight and for knowing which is which.

items.name: Smoked Loupe
items.flavour: A smoked lens in a felt eyecup on a cord, for judging a pour by its colour.

items.name: Manganese Plumb Bob
items.flavour: A manganese steel plumb bob that hangs true in a furnace draught.

items.name: Tuyere Rosette
items.flavour: A felt rosette pinned through a ring of tuyere bronze, which the Foundry gives nobody, so you gave it yourself.

items.name: Pyrometer Fob
items.flavour: Three opal pyrometers on a fob, which agree about the heat more often than not.

items.name: Bronze Pick
items.flavour: A bronze pick that bites tin ore and leaves the copper to the tip.

items.name: Nickel Steel Pick
items.flavour: A nickel steel pick that keeps its point in a seam warm enough to boil a kettle.

items.name: Manganese Pick
items.flavour: A manganese steel pick that wears out the rock before the rock wears out the pick.

items.name: Opal-Tipped Pick
items.flavour: A manganese steel pick with a fire opal in the heel, so you can find it in a dark seam.

items.name: Bronze Tongs
items.flavour: Long bronze tongs that hold a bar in the fire while you stand somewhere cooler.

items.name: Nickel Steel Tongs
items.flavour: Nickel steel tongs that stay stiff in a forge that would soften a bronze pair.

items.name: Manganese Tongs
items.flavour: Manganese steel tongs with jaws that close like a door and open like a bank.

items.name: Crucible Tongs
items.flavour: Cast-iron crucible tongs on clinker bar handles, long enough to lift a melt without meeting it.

items.name: Bronze Salvage Hook
items.flavour: A bronze hook on a pole, for pulling good iron out of a heap that would rather keep it.

items.name: Nickel Steel Salvage Hook
items.flavour: A nickel steel hook that goes into a hot slag heap and comes out with something.

items.name: Manganese Salvage Hook
items.flavour: A manganese steel hook that prises a tuyere out of a furnace wall without asking the wall.

items.name: Clinker Hook
items.flavour: A clinker bar bent into a hook and tipped with tuyere bronze, which breaks a heap and searches it.

items.name: Bronze Driver Roll
items.flavour: A canvas roll of bronze drivers, which will not spark beside a gas main.

items.name: Nickel Steel Driver Roll
items.flavour: A roll of nickel steel drivers that turn a seized Foundry screw and keep their tips.

items.name: Manganese Driver Roll
items.flavour: A roll of manganese steel drivers and gauges, hard enough to outlast the work.

items.name: Instrument Maker's Roll
items.flavour: A roll of manganese drivers with a pyrometer's opal set in the clasp, for reading the heat of the work.

items.name: Bronze Needle Case
items.flavour: A bronze needle case packed in slag wool, so the needles stay sharp and the wool stays where it is.

items.name: Nickel Steel Needle Case
items.flavour: A nickel steel case of needles stiff enough to go through slag felt at the first try.

items.name: Manganese Needle Case
items.flavour: A felt-lined manganese steel needle case, its needles stiff enough for a double fold of slag felt.

items.name: Cast Iron Needle Case
items.flavour: A needle case cut from a spoiled casting and lined with felt, heavy enough to hold a pattern flat.
